The `fallbackPostureFor` utility function performs a spread operation on `new Set(fallbackReasonCodes)`. If `fallbackReasonCodes` is null, undefined, or not iterable, this will throw a `TypeError` and crash the script.

To ensure robustness and fail-closed behavior, verify that `fallbackReasonCodes` is a valid array before spreading, defaulting to an empty array if it is not.

```suggestion
function fallbackPostureFor({ displayPosture, fallbackReasonCodes }) {
  const reasonCodes = [...new Set(Array.isArray(fallbackReasonCodes) ? fallbackReasonCodes : [])].sort();
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure utility functions (such as sorting, filtering, or mapping helpers) are robust against non-array inputs by returning a safe default (e.g., an empty array) to fail closed gracefully instead of throwing a TypeError.
</details>

There is a significant amount of code duplication (11 helper functions, ~150 lines of complex business logic) between `build-question-runtime-payload-artifact-adapter.mjs` and `build-question-runtime-payload-schema.mjs`. Verbatim duplication of functions like `isVisualRequired`, `normalizedDisplayPosture`, and `visualDisplayGovernanceFor` increases maintenance overhead and the risk of desynchronization when changes are made.

Consider extracting these shared posture mapping and governance helpers into a common utility module (e.g., `scripts/method-map/posture-helpers.mjs`) and importing them into both files. When refactoring these scripts that generate build artifacts, ensure you run focused verification (e.g., using a '--check' command) to confirm that the generated artifact hashes remain unchanged and no regressions are introduced.

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When refactoring or optimizing scripts that generate build artifacts (such as manifests, readbacks, or validator results), run focused verification (e.g., using a '--check' command) to confirm that the generated artifact hashes remain unchanged and no regressions are introduced.
</details>

Verification: focused runtime-payload Jest suites passed, 4 suites / 30 tests; regenerated artifacts had no checked-in artifact diff; `git diff --check` passed; preflight exited 0.
